I just came back from a 45 minute drive on this model, all winding city streets. (I have NNLC off and Live Delay on). At first it was favoring the left edge of the lanes, but the latter half of the drive was centered fairly well. It followed the curves from the start, never crossed a lane line or threatened to hit a curb. It stops well with a lead car, but not as well without. It slows radically for intersections that don't have stop signs or lights (from 30 down to 16) when in the right lane. In the left lane or center of 3 lanes it seems to continue without slowing. It did a few stops signs nearly perfectly (slightly rolling stop) even without a lead in front of it.

There was one intersection (a red light) near the start of my ride where I manually braked to a stop and then re-engaged SP. It immediately moved so I put the brake on again. Did that twice at that same light. It may have something to do with the fact that I was on an uphill section right there so the traffic light was lower in the camera than normal; might have thought it was farther from the light than it wanted to be.
